title.narrative: IFCA contribution to ¿Framework for Technical Assistance in Kazakhstan¿

description.narrative: The Framework for Technical Assistance in Kazakhstan (the Framework) would provide financing of pre- and post-signing technical assistance (TA) components in sectors prioritised by IFCA, e.g. Feasibility Studies, Due Diligence, Project Implementation Support, Corporate Development, Creditworthiness Enhancement Programmes etc. These TA components would ensure appropriate and effective project preparation and implementation of investments being financed by the EBRD.
